SELECT to_char(A.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS effDate ,A.NON_STANDARD_LIMIT AS nonStandardLimit ,A.NON_STANDARD_ROTIO AS nonStandardRotio ,B.TARGET_SCALE AS totalPlannedAssets FROM NON_STANDARD_MAINT A LEFT JOIN ASSET_PLAN_INFO B ON B.VDATE <=A.EFF_DATE AND A.EFF_DATE <= B.EDATE WHERE 1=1
and ( A.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{toDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and A.EFF_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
select count (*) from NON_STANDARD_MAINT where EFF_DATE=TO_DATE(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
